audience: NKCDC Economic Development leadership and program stakeholders reviewing a broader Phase Two growth partnership for Philadelphia community and small-business programs.
outcome: A presentation-ready eight-page US Letter portrait strategy deck that helps NKCDC choose the first two or three growth priorities for a focused 90-day pilot without implying that every opportunity is approved or launching at once.

contentOrder: What Phase One taught us, and what Phase Two unlocks
Phase Two opportunities for NKCDC growth
One growth system, multiple NKCDC priorities
How each priority becomes a campaign
How we will know Phase Two is working
hierarchyRules: The first three pages must read as an organization-wide growth proposal.
Programs and channel opportunities appear before technical implementation details.
SEO, AEO, technical content, and AI visibility are visibly subordinate to the broader growth model.
Each page has one dominant claim and uses diagrams only when they clarify a relationship or sequence.
Tighten copy before reducing type below a comfortable presentation size.

brandAssets: Use the NKCDC logo embedded in the supplied source deck when technically feasible.
Do not redraw, regenerate, distort, recolor, or alter the NKCDC mark.
Treat source/NKCDC-Strategy-Overview.pdf as the visual asset reference, not the strategic copy source.
